s: Dinim hannohagim bime haomer ubo t' seipim: nohagin shello lissa ishsha veshello lehistapper ben pesach laatzeret, shemmitabbelin al k"d alapim mittalmide rabbi aqiba shemmetu bayyamim hallalu. Abal muttar laasot shiddukin [o qiddushin] belo nissuin, shemma yaqdimennu acher. Umuttar gam ken laasot seuda leachar hashshiddukin o leachar haqqiddushin. Abal lo yaasu riqqudin umecholot. Veen tzarik lomar shello yaasu riqqudin umecholot shel reshut. Abal muttar laasot seudat hareshut, kegon simchat mereut, belo riqqudin umecholot usemachot yeterot:
Mi sheqqapatz venasa bayyamim hallalu — en qonesin oto kelum, kevan sheasa mitzva. Abal mi shehistapper bayyamim hallalu — qonesin oto al sheabar al hamminhag:

Mi shello qiyyem adayin mitzvat periyya urebiyya o sheen lo mi sheyyeshammeshennu, kevan shemmuttar lo lissa apillu betok sheloshim laabelut abiv veimmo shechayyab lehitabbel alehem miggezerat chakamim, kol shekken shemmuttar lo lissa baabelut yamim hallalu sheenan ella minhag beolma. Umikkol maqom, bimdinot ellu nahagu lehachmir:
Kesheyyesh mila bayyamim hallalu — muttarim baale habberit, dehaynu hammohel vehassandaq vaabi habben, bayyom shellipne hammila samuk laereb qodem halika lebet hakkeneset lehistapper:

L"g yamim yesh omerim shehem matchilin miyyom rishon shel sepirat haomer umesayyemin bel"g baomer, shebbeoto yom metu haacharonim shel hak"d elep. Lepikak nohagin qetzat leharbot besimcha beyom zeh, veen omerim bo tachanun, lepi shebbo bayyom pasequ lamut. Veap shemmetu miqtzat mehem beyom zeh, mikkol maqom hare leinyan abelut yom haacharon anu omerim: "miqtzat hayyom kekullo", kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman shtz"h, lepikak keshennoheg abelut shaa achat o pachot beyom l"g, dehaynu shemmonea millehistapper ad leachar sheheir hayyom bel"g — day bekak, umuttar lo lehistapper bel"g leachar sheaberu mashshehu mehayyom velissa bo ishsha, veken mil"g vaelak. Veim chal l"g beechad bashshabbat — nohagin lehistapper beereb shabbat mippene kebod hashshabbat. Umikkol maqom, apillu bel"g atzmo yizzaher shello lehistapper qodem or hayyom, lepi sheen omerim ella "miqtzat hayyom kekullo", abal layla apillu kullah — enah kekol hayyom, velo posqa abelut ad lemachar bayyom. Velaken omerim tachanun bitpillat hammincha shel ereb l"g. Veyesh meqomot nohagin shello lomar tachanun bemincha shel ereb l"g, lepi shessomekin shebbitchillat lel l"g pasequ haabelut, velaken en omerim tachanun bemincha shellepanayv, kemo sheen omerim bemincha shellipne shear hayyamim sheen omerim bahem tachanun shellelam keyomam. Ulepi minhagam muttarim gam ken lehistapper velissa belel l"g (shellepi dibrehem en nohagin abelut ella l"b yom):

Veyesh omerim shel"g yamim ellu matchilin miyyom b' lechodesh iyyar umesayyemin beereb shabuot. Veap al pi shemmuttar lehistapper velissa bel"g baomer, mikkol maqom kevan sheen hetter ella leachar sheabar miqtzat hayyom shehu kekullo, laken oleh hal"g baomer gam ken lecheshbon hal"g yamim shennohagin bahem abelut. Veal pi dibrehem yesh nohagin lehistapper velissa bekol shelosha yeme hagbala, ella shehem en mistapperin venosein berosh chodesh iyyar ella ad rosh chodesh bilbad velo ad biklal, kede sheyyihyu nohagin abelut l"g yamim, shehen matchilin berosh chodesh iyyar umesayyemin beyom rishon shel hahagbala. Umiqtzat oto yom haacharon hu kekullo, velaken mistapperin venosein mishsheheir yom rishon shel hagbala vaelak:

Im yesh lo sapeq beminhag hammaqom — eno yakol litpos qulle hamminhagim, dehaynu sheyyinhag hetter ad rosh chodesh iyyar kassebara haacharona, vegam yinhag hetter mil"g baomer vaelak ad ereb atzeret kassebara harishona, kevan sheb' qullot ellu soterot zo et zo. Abal yakol litpos chumre hamminhagim, dehaynu sheyyinhag issur mippesach vead ereb shabuot o ad yom rishon shel hagbala chutz mil"g baomer. Veap shennoheg b' chumrot shessoterot zo et zo — eno kiksil haholek bachoshek, kevan sheasa ken mechamat hassapeq shennistappeq lo ezeh minhag hu iqqar. Umikkol maqom, en tzarik laasot ken, ella yakol litpos ezeh minhag sheyyirtzeh, veen chosheshin shemma minhag maqom hazzeh eno ken, kevan sheabelut enah ella minhag beolma — en lehachmir bispeqa. Abal im yadua lo minhag hammaqom — en lo leshannot min minhag hammaqom lehaqel bayyamim sheanshe hammaqom machamirin, o lehachamir bayyamim shehen meqillin, im eno oseh ken mechamat chumra beolma shemmachamir al atzmo lachosh ledibre hammachamirin beyamim ellu, ella hu mitraeh sheoseh ken lepi shekken rauy laasot lekol adam, mippene shehaiqqar hu kehammachamirin, sheaz nireh haddabar kishte torot, shehu machamir veanshe hammaqom meqillin o lehepek, veyesh bazeh issur "lo titgodedu", kelomar: lo taasu aguddot aguddot. Apillu im hu beinyan sheen lachosh lemachaloqet, kegon sheen hu yechidi bair ella harbeh meanshe hammaqom nohagin kak veharbeh mehen nohagin kak, veen maqpidin zeh al zeh kelal:

Ap lehannohagin issur gam ad rosh chodesh iyyar, mikkol maqom im chal beshabbat, kevan sheyyesh kan tosepet simcha, shabbat verosh chodesh — yesh lehattir lehistapper beereb shabbat mippene kebod hashshabbat, vegam lissa ishsha bo bayyom, kevan sheiqqar seudat hannissuin yihyeh beshabbat verosh chodesh:

Nohagin shello laasot melaka echad anashim veechad nashim kol yeme hassepira mishsheqiat hachamma ad leachar sepirat haomer, veremez lazeh, shenneemar "sheba shabbatot", milleshon shebut, shebbizman hassepira, dehaynu mishsheqiat hachamma vaelak, yesh lishbot mimmelaka ad leachar sheyyispor (veotan hannashim sheenan soperot — epshar sheyyesh [lahen lishbot] mimmelaka kol hallayla):
